hints.title: Target Team Skill Sum
hints.text: Every team consists of exactly 2 players. To make all teams have equal total skill, pair the smallest remaining player with the largest remaining player.

hints.title: Opposite Ends Pairing
hints.text: Sort the skill array. The required target sum must equal skill[0] + skill[-1].

hints.title: Chemistry Accumulation
hints.text: Iterate two boundary indices inward: if any pair does not equal the target sum, return -1; otherwise add skill[i] * skill[n-1-i] to chemistry.

hints.title: Sorted Extremes Pairing Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def dividePlayers(self, skill: list[int]) -> int:
        skill.sort()
        n = len(skill)
        target = skill[0] + skill[-1]
        chemistry = 0
        i, j = 0, n - 1
        while i < j:
            if skill[i] + skill[j] != target:
                return -1
            chemistry += skill[i] * skill[j]
            i += 1
            j -= 1
        return chemistry
```

complexity.notes: Sorting dominates the linear two-pointer pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sorts skills and pairs opposite ends while validating uniform pair sum.
